name: Kokoro no Tobira
source:
In Spring main characters moves away from his just married brother and starts living alone. He has to share flat with non-related by blood niece and her best friend. What will relations between three people evolve to? Can young people find the right key to each other's heart?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
春天，主角搬离刚刚结婚的哥哥家，开始独立生活。他不得不与没有血缘关系的侄女及她的好友同住。三人的关系会如何发展？年轻人们能找到打开彼此心扉的钥匙吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
